items.title: From HVLD Syringe Inspection to Automated Line Clearance Systems
items.summary: Small-scale pharmaceutical production is becoming more and more important across the pharmaceutical industry. At CPHI Milan, Marchesini will present solutions for this segment alongside a predictive maintenance platform, an OEB5-contained capsule-filling machine, inspection technology using high-voltage leak detection (HVLD) and developments in automated line clearance.
